answer: Like an intertwining vine rooting through living mycelium, our consensus weaves trust into an opal lattice of verified peer bonds. An unvalidated identity is merely a flickering ember adrift from the collective warmth. Through transitive web-of-trust decay and graph-flow bottlenecks, minting counterfeit agents imposes a superlinear attacker cost: forging synthetic consensus demands exponentially multiplying collateralized staking.
